sources.name: MTA Subway Stations
sources.publisher: Metropolitan Transportation Authority / Open Data NY
sources.license: Open Data NY Terms of Use
sources.crs_transform: Published WGS84 lat/lon cross-checked with source GeoJSON point
sources.routing_usage: Queryable official transit context; existing Transit Connectivity scoring snapshot unchanged
sources.source_record_identity: Published station stop ID; entrance attribute/geometry hash; bus published stop ID plus exact coordinates. No name-only entity matching.
limitations: Station ADA flags do not establish a step-free walking path or currently working elevator.
Entrance data has a 2024 observation vintage; publisher update is not a new field survey.
Bus route-stop relationships are grouped, not added up as separate physical stops. No timetable or real-time arrivals/alerts are claimed.
